name: International Building Code
note: The general row; inside a dwelling the IBC and the IRC allow a riser of 7 3/4 in and a going of 10 in. The IBC has no step rule and counts no risers in a flight: `step_min`, `step_max`, `going_max` and `flight_risers_max` are forgiving numbers. Winders are allowed inside dwellings only. Inches, written in millimetres.

sources.stairs.going_max: Not in the code: a forgiving number
sources.stairs.step_min: Not in the code: a forgiving number
sources.stairs.step_max: Not in the code: a forgiving number
sources.stairs.flight_risers_max: Not in the code: a forgiving number
sources.stairs.landing_rule: IBC 2021 1011.6, as deep as the stair is wide
sources.stairs.landing_length: IBC 2021 1011.6, 48 in where the stair runs straight
sources.stairs.walk_line: IBC 2021 1011.5.3, 12 in from the narrow side
sources.stairs.winder_going_min: IBC 2021 1011.5.3, 11 in at the walk line
